description:
Run the agentic auto-sync pipeline on a clip with a source recording: detects natural sync points (UI changes, narrated steps) and inserts sync-marker nodes into its transcript. Required before voiceover TTS on video clips (clueso://docs/sync-points).

Skips (no run): "audio_extracted" (read-only transcript); "clip_busy" + held_by (retry later); "clip_too_long" + {clip_id, duration_label} (trimmed window over 5 min; never quote the limit): split_clip it into shorter clips and auto_sync each; "no_script": the clip has no voiceover text to place markers in, so set it first (voiceover_batch set_text). "not_a_video_clip": slide and blank clips have no recording to sync to.

Returns once started; markers land a few seconds later, so poll get_clip(select:['sync_points']) before TTS.
name: auto_sync
title: Auto-generate sync points
